agent_explanation: Single heavy circle falls under gravity and bounces on floor y=0 between steps 60-61. Incident vy=-18.67 becomes rebound vy=+19.73, i.e. speed increases despite e=0.907 (expected ~16.9). With no controller work, total energy jumps from ~3017 J to ~3363 J, exceeding E0+10%+5J. Likely cause: floor impulse/positional-correction adds energy at high impact speed (substeps=7), effectively restitution>1, possibly gravity applied inside substep collision loop or over-correction.
